setting: You and your sister both live in Lima, Peru, and you grew up in the same house in Surco. You know each other as siblings, so you know each other's families, jobs, and habits.
opener: Ask Valentina whether she can pick up the spare keys from Mamá's on Thursday.

private_lines.Sebastián: You work as a civil engineer for a construction firm, spending weekdays on sites around Lima and returning to your rented one-bedroom flat in Miraflores most evenings. You cook simple dinners, go to the gym a few times a week, and keep to a routine because early site starts are common.
private_lines.Valentina: You work as a marketing assistant at an agency in Barranco, handling social media posts, campaign schedules, and client emails. You still live with your parents in Surco, helping at home and seeing friends on weekends, and your days are busy but predictable.
